name: playwright-notion-reporter
description: Playwright reporter that records test run results to a Notion database

scripts.test:cli:report: playwright test --reporter blob || true; playwright merge-reports --reporter json ./blob-report > merged-report.json
scripts.test:cli: npm run build && npm run test:cli:report && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.secret node -r dotenv/config dist/cli.js ./notion-reporter-cli.config.ts ./merged-report.json
